name: Cemu · Wii U
description: Select a decrypted WUA or an RPX in its authorized game folder. Encrypted WUD/WUX and online accounts are not included. Connect an SDL Xbox pad before Play. It maps to a Wii U GamePad. Xbox View/Back toggles GamePad view and sends Minus. Touch/gyro-only actions are outside this pad-only matrix.
provenance: Official upstream artifact pinned by SHA-256; no games, accounts or firmware
